issue_context.title: Sensibo Fan Mode partially broken after 2023.09
issue_context.body:
### The problem

After the update of HA 2023.09 the Sensibo integration does not recogize the fan mode "strong" anymore.

When trying to select "strong" from the menu i get "Could not call service climate/set_fan_mode climate fan mode strong is not supported by the integration"

### What version of Home Assistant Core has the issue?

core-2023.9.1

### What was the last working version of Home Assistant Core?

core-2023.8

### What type of installation are you running?

Home Assistant OS

### Integration causing the issue

Sensibo

https://www.home-assistant.io/integrations/sensibo
